target: Pinned huggingface/speech-to-speech OpenAI-Realtime-compatible local server integrated behind the existing Frankenstein 2.0 voice boundary
purpose: Falsify protocol compatibility specifically at the barge-in heard/unheard boundary, conversation authority boundary, tool cancellation boundary and zero-external-inference boundary before treating the local cascade as a drop-in realtime transport replacement.

f2_required_semantics: queued unheard output is cancelled with heard_fraction=0 and commit_eligible=false
started/heard output interrupted by barge-in remains non-commit-eligible
only fully heard completed output may become commit-eligible
VoiceOutcome result reference requires fully heard commit-eligible output

oracle_law: Stopping audio generation is not sufficient if server-side conversation context still contains assistant content the user never heard.
The local speech server may be a transport/inference organ but may not become a competing canonical session, memory, tool, effect, or heard-state authority.
A barge-in must terminate or fence every stale response/TTS/tool producer causally attached to the interrupted turn.
Any server-internal assistant history beyond the F2 heard boundary must be truncated, replaced, reconstructed from F2 authority, or proven unable to influence later model context.
Unknown or unsupported realtime events must fail visibly; silent compatibility downgrade is forbidden.
Network-blocked acceptance must prove zero external ASR, LLM and TTS inference calls.

falsifiers.action: Connect the existing F2 realtime-client adapter to the pinned local server and enumerate every client/server event actually exchanged during session open, one voice turn, one tool turn and close.
must_hold: all F2-required events map deterministically or through one explicit adapter
unknown event produces explicit typed incompatibility
no hidden second conversation authority is introduced
falsifiers.falsifies_if: required client behavior is silently ignored or coerced into a different semantic meaning

falsifiers.action: Start an assistant response long enough to buffer output ahead of playback; record generated text/audio boundary and F2 heard boundary; issue response.cancel plus output_audio_buffer.clear at a known interruption point.
must_hold: future audio generation stops
queued/unheard local playback is cleared
F2 commit_eligible remains false for interrupted segment
next-turn model context contains no assistant content beyond the measured heard boundary
falsifiers.falsifies_if: later model context contains any assistant text/audio semantics that F2 classified as unheard

falsifiers.action: Send conversation.item.truncate using the expected OpenAI-Realtime shape. If unsupported, exercise the intended F2 adapter fallback and inspect the next model prompt/context.
must_hold: either exact truncate-equivalent semantics are supported
or F2 reconstructs authoritative next-turn context from its own heard-state boundary so server history cannot leak unheard text
unsupported truncate cannot be treated as successful no-op
falsifiers.falsifies_if: truncate is ignored and server-retained unheard assistant content influences the next response

falsifiers.action: Trigger a function/tool call, barge in before its result returns, then deliver the late result while a new user turn is active.
must_hold: late old-turn tool result cannot acquire current-turn ownership
cancelled response cannot resume from the late result
F2 tool/effect authority remains the deciding boundary
falsifiers.falsifies_if: late tool data mutates current conversation or causes output without an explicit new causal bridge

falsifiers.action: Issue repeated response.cancel/output clear and inject or observe a late TTS/audio chunk from the cancelled generation.
must_hold: cancellation is idempotent
late audio is discarded by generation/epoch identity
heard_fraction and commit eligibility cannot increase after interruption
falsifiers.falsifies_if: late cancelled-generation audio is played or becomes durable spoken history

falsifiers.action: Disconnect/reconnect or restart the local speech server while preserving F2 VoiceSessionCapsule/UnifiedDB authority; resume using an explicit reentry adapter.
must_hold: speech-server connection/session IDs are treated as transient transport identities
F2 causal identity remains authoritative
cancelled/unheard output is not resurrected
tool ownership does not survive unless explicitly reconstructed by F2 policy
falsifiers.falsifies_if: speech-server restart/reconnect changes canonical conversation identity or resurrects stale work

falsifiers.action: With the intended local STT backend, run progressive transcription on a fixed German utterance and count accumulated-utterance retranscriptions, CPU/GPU utilization and user-end-to-first-response timing.
must_hold: request amplification is measured
late progressive result cannot override final transcript
resource/latency remains within the selected hardware envelope or progressive mode is explicitly disabled/adapted
falsifiers.falsifies_if: progressive retranscription causes unbounded request amplification, final-state regression or unacceptable measured latency

falsifiers.action: Run the exact pinned stack with external inference/network egress blocked except localhost/internal required transport; execute one German session including STT, response generation, TTS and tool bridge.
must_hold: external ASR inference calls==0
external LLM inference calls==0
external TTS inference calls==0
no hidden hosted fallback occurs
all model/artifact provenance is pinned
falsifiers.falsifies_if: any external inference call or silent hosted fallback is required

execution_contract.preferred_surface: lowest safe faithful VPS sandbox / clay-direct-dev under existing Trigger4 execution authority

next_exact_action: The existing semantic-claim owner should consume this falsifier packet instead of opening another claim. Execute HF01-HF03 first because the heard-boundary/history result decides whether preserving the OpenAI-Realtime transport boundary is architecturally viable. If the server lacks truncate-equivalent history semantics, prefer a narrow F2 adapter that keeps canonical conversation context outside the speech server rather than granting the server authority.
